passed: The live status region announces actual room or schedule changes, outage, and recovery without announcing routine timestamp changes.
The timestamp remains visible and is updated with both its datetime value and text; it does not need to be in a live region.
The refresh cadence is qualified for page visibility and delayed responses.
notes: Keeping the timestamp outside the live region is appropriate: WCAG does not require announcing every routine timestamp update, and doing so every 10 seconds could be disruptive.
